content_text: In alpha capture, one rule outranks the rest: never trade the level, trade the delta: Omer Cedar spent years at Two Sigma turning analyst behavior into systematic alpha. He explains: "The deltas — the change in information — matter more than the levels." "The change in state is usually one of the strongest signals you can have." "Especially when it runs opposite to the level." "Somebody with no view suddenly has a view. That change in state is a very powerful change." "That's a person who analyzed and analyzed and finally decided it's time to commit. Real information." "Incrementally more bullish is good information. Off the fence for the first time is the trade."
